scope_definition: Kernel proof of mathematical enumeration/transition/retrograde models, hash-bound finite input checks, explicit source correspondence, and bounded tests of frozen production routines. Not a universal C++ language-refinement theorem.
boundaries: Kernel theorems certify explicit models and contracts. The concrete local/directory facts still rely on hash-bound compiled Lean checks.
Bottom-up correctness starts from an empty model table and proves existence and truth of computed labels under complete successors, complete states, decreasing edge rank and sorted processing order.
The cached row is connected to the original SAFE game under explicit candidate-piece layout, accurate bucket counts, valid candidate addresses and previously justified child strategies.
Duplicate/sort and MovePlans models are proved universally on their stated bounded domains. Translation of the entire optimized C++ loop and memory model is not kernel proved.
102 production-routine configurations use synthetic child labels; 13741216 row comparisons and all fault probes do not add historical P/N facts.
Prior full reverse replay uses a different physical-deletion recurrence but shares the rules and Index; it is computational evidence, not independent formalization.
The historical empty-P result remains supported by computation and replay, without end-to-end Lean acceptance of every output bit.
